question: Which soft metal in group 1 of the periodic table tarnishes within a few seconds of exposure to air?
solution:
The correct answer is **Sodium**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sodium** is a soft metal in group 1 of the periodic table.
 
• It tarnishes within a few seconds of exposure to air due to the formation of sodium oxide.
 
• This rapid tarnishing is due to its high reactivity with oxygen and moisture in the air.
 
• To prevent tarnishing, sodium is often stored in oil or an inert atmosphere.<
